TDOP Changelog
Terminal D Operations Briefing
V1.0.3 April 2026 CURRENT
  • Traffic button — 📋 Traffic is now one button with an AM / PM / O/N dropdown. Each option is a fixed clock-time window, independent of whatever shift the rest of TDOP is currently showing: AM 04:30–14:30, PM 14:00–23:59, O/N 21:00–04:30 (overnight stands only: D6, D8A, D10–D16X, T83–T93).
  • SeeSay button — new 👁 SeeSay button posts a Teams adaptive card via Power Automate directing staff to submit IOC requests through the SeeSay app, with a direct mobile link. Always enabled.
  • Teams gated badge fix — Teams card posts now correctly show the <strong>✈ GATED</strong> indicator when a card's Gated toggle is active. Previously the styled badge was stripped by Teams' HTML sanitiser.
  • QSG & User Guide updated — both documents reflect V1.0.3 features including Traffic, O/N Traffic, and SeeSay.
V1.0 April 2026
  • Gate/Pad Change Detection — baseline captured on first pull; auto-refresh compares each cycle and flags reassigned gates or stands with an amber ⚠ Gate/Pad Changed badge in the card header and highlights the changed cell
  • Tooltip on changed cells — hover the amber Gate or Stand cell to see the original value
  • Export propagation — Gate/Pad Changed badge carried into HS Ops, LF Ops, Hardstand Email, and all shared card exports
  • Baseline lifecycle — baseline resets on Nuclear Clear and nightly 3:00 AM wipe; new entries appearing mid-day seed without a flag
V4.0 April 2026
  • v2 API — all data pulls and auto-refreshes now use the Better Airport v2 endpoint
  • ETA/ETD conditional display — estimated times only show when they differ from the scheduled time; suppressed at the data layer across all views and exports
  • HS Ops export redesigned — now mirrors the main Email export exactly: 8-column table with Flight, City, SKD, ETA/ETD, Gate, Stand, PAX, and Type per row
  • ETA/ETD column header — terminal cards in email export now show "ETA/ETD" instead of "EST"
  • Gate Gadget SVG logo — replaces the previous PNG; crisp at all resolutions
  • Light theme default — app defaults to light regardless of OS setting; toggle still available
  • API estimated time pre-fill — ETA/ETD inputs auto-populate from the API on pull and every 5-minute refresh; user-entered values always win
  • Codeshare filter — two-layer guard blocks codeshares marketed under excluded carriers
  • 30-minute auto-save, live sync & nightly reset — KV state persistence across machines with 10-second sync and 3:00 AM daily wipe
